title: One-sided acceptance of conductive manufacturing powder with bounded shielded closed-void fraction, despite unknown exterior shape.

statement.current_best: UNKNOWN for a matched per-particle certificate. Source-reported comparators include vacuum AC DEP, size-binned hollow-powder airflow sorting, and XCT/radiography; no superiority is established.
statement.limitation: A theorem requiring true Tr(alpha)/m and per-particle material bounds does not acquire them on moving, rotating, coated particles.
statement.problem: One-sided acceptance of conductive manufacturing powder with bounded shielded closed-void fraction, despite unknown exterior shape.
statement.proposed_mechanism: Acquire a conservatively covered upper response bound through signed field/trajectory metrology; apply the conditional inverse-trace/mass inequality; sort separately.

target.comparator: Matched accuracy, coverage, admitted material class, accepted mass yield and total cost/energy comparison remains UNKNOWN.
target.conditions: Design target only: nominal 30 micrometre conductive particles with certified per-particle premises. Immediate milestone is one blinded particle/reference set; 1 kg/h is a later unachieved target.
target.metric: maximum shielded closed-void fraction among accepted admitted particles

contract.assumptions: Design target only: nominal 30 micrometre conductive particles with certified per-particle premises. Immediate milestone is one blinded particle/reference set; 1 kg/h is a later unachieved target.
contract.costs: First one-particle blinded apparatus and independent bounded ground truth, cost UNKNOWN. Later neighbor/actuator tests, then a 500–1000 particle/s lane; 1 kg/h needs ~7.28 million nominal particles/s.

assumptions: Bounded connected C^{1,beta} filled conductor; electrically shielded closed cavities only; positive static polarizability tensor.
For each admitted particle: valid density/nonmetal-mass/physical-to-PEC trace bounds, not bulk-average estimates.
Ideal projection fixes position, orientation, charge and free-space affine-field environment across signs; real residuals require a new bound.
field_details.conservation_and_thermodynamics: Electrostatic self-force cancels; G is symmetric trace-free in source-free vacuum. The signed data projection is not a net passive-force or free-energy gain. All preparation/control/recovery costs remain charged.
field_details.energy_balance: UNKNOWN measured energy per accepted kg. Charge pumping, field drives, illumination/readout, tracking, feeding, actuation, recovery and cleaning; the unipolar displacement calculator is not the signed instrument energy budget.
field_details.error_budget: Signed measurement phases, electrical versus mass/optical center, finite electrodes/images/higher harmonics, coating dynamics, gas drag, neighbors, calibration drift and systematic negative bias must be bounded on admitted particles.
field_details.governing_equations: alpha=epsilon0 M; V Tr(M^-1)<=1 (imported); Tr(alpha)>=9epsilon0 V; R=Tr(alpha)/m; phi<=1-K/R_U. Fixed affine-field F=qe+Gp; four-sign projection extracts G alpha e.
field_details.input_acquisition: Acquire a true upper bound on trace/mass, actual trajectory/rotation, charge and field waveform/geometry; independently acquire material premises and reference void ground truth. No instrument or tomography interface is free.
field_details.materials: Nominal Al rho=2700 kg/m^3 is an assumption; oxide/coating, nonmetal mass, alloy density and finite-frequency response must be bounded per particle.
field_details.reliability: Freeze one-sided response coverage and admission rules. Illustrative hour-wide 1% risk uses a union bound and assumed calibrated Gaussian tails; no industrial tail guarantee or independence follows from a small trial.
field_details.resources: First one-particle blinded apparatus and independent bounded ground truth, cost UNKNOWN. Later neighbor/actuator tests, then a 500–1000 particle/s lane; 1 kg/h needs ~7.28 million nominal particles/s.
field_details.units_and_tolerances: SI alpha and particle mass; R in polarizability/kg; void fraction dimensionless. Nominal 30 micrometre diameter, E=1e6 V/m and g=1e9 V/m^2 are design inputs. 0.2% repeatability is not coverage; the source illustrates a stricter ~0.046% random target under specific material/risk assumptions.
